analysis.approveDrafts: Approve {count} drafts | Approve {count} draft | Approve {count} drafts
analysis.noSessionsTitle: This assembly has no sessions yet
analysis.noSessionsHint: Add a session on the Sessions tab; findings appear here once its tables have been analyzed.
analysis.notConfiguredHint: An administrator needs to add an analysis API key (Mistral, Ollama Cloud, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) in Settings. Analysis then runs automatically after each table is transcribed.
analysis.inProgressHint: Tables are being analyzed — findings appear here automatically.
analysis.noFindingsHint: Findings appear automatically after tables are recorded and transcribed, or run the analysis manually.
analysis.noMatchHint: Change the filters above to see the rest of this session's findings.

comparison.title: Speaking balance across tables
comparison.intro: Each line measures one table on its own — voices are detected, not identified, and talk-time is an estimate, not a measure of influence.

analysis.crossTableNote: Cross-table findings are regenerated every time a table finishes its analysis, reviews included — review them after the last table.
analysis.analyzedNoFindings: Analyzed — no substantive findings for the session question in this discussion.
analysis.footer: AI findings are drafts until a human approves them; summaries are AI-generated neutral descriptions. Every finding cites transcript evidence; “mentioned at N tables” is never a measure of participant support.

toast.nothingToAnalyze: Nothing to analyze — no table has a transcript ready yet
toast.cancelledRunning: {cancelled} pending job(s) cancelled; {running} already running will finish

confirmApprove.title: Approve every draft finding?
confirmApprove.message: {count} draft finding(s) in this session will be marked approved and included in the report. Rejected findings are left alone, and you can still edit or reject any of them afterwards.

confirmRerun.title: Run the analysis again?
confirmRerun.messageReviewed: Every finding of this session — including the {count} you have already approved or edited — is replaced by a freshly generated set. Reviews done so far will have to be redone.
confirmRerun.messageDrafts: Every draft finding for this session is replaced with freshly generated ones.

confirmRecluster.title: Run the cross-table clustering again?
confirmRecluster.message: The {count} cross-table finding(s) you have already approved or edited are replaced by a freshly generated set, along with the drafts. Table findings are not touched.

toast.closed: Session closed — the final report is ready
toast.reopened: Session reopened — tables can record again
toast.unpublished: Report is no longer visible on table phones
toast.published: Report published — table phones can now view and download it
toast.synthesisQueued: Synthesis queued — it appears here in a minute or two
toast.refreshed: The published version now matches the current report
toast.downloadFailed: The report could not be downloaded — check the pop-up blocker

report.finalHint: The session is closed: tables can no longer record, and this is the definitive report. Participants keep reading this version even if you reopen — approve more findings and press Update to push them.
report.allDoneHint: Close the session to create the final report and enable the downloads.
report.interimTitle: Interim report — {complete} of {expected} tables have completed all sessions
report.interimHint: This is a preview of an assembly still in progress. Closing the session creates the final report and enables the downloads — you can reopen later.

synthesis.title: How the discussion developed
synthesis.haveLead: A chapter across the sessions, written from their summaries and approved cross-table findings
synthesis.haveTail: It is remade at closing once every session's analysis is in.
synthesis.none: Once at least two sessions have a summary, the analysis model writes how the discussion moved from the first session to the last. It happens by itself at closing; generate it earlier here.
synthesis.carried: Carried from one session to the next

report.downloadsLocked: Downloads become available once the session is closed.
report.unpublishedTitle: Not yet published to table phones
report.publishedHint: Recording phones can view this report and download the PDF (approved findings and AI summaries only — drafts stay private).
report.unpublishedHint: Publishing lets the recording phones view this report and download the PDF. Only approved findings and AI summaries are shared.
report.emptyHintDrafts: No findings exist yet — record tables and run the analysis first.
report.emptyHintApproved: No approved findings yet. Approve findings in the Analysis tab, or include drafts to preview.
report.speaker: Speaker

confirmClose.title: Close the session and create the final report?
confirmClose.missingTables: Tables {tables} never recorded — they will not appear in the final report.
confirmClose.body: Tables can no longer record after closing, and the report becomes final. You can reopen the session later if a late table needs to record.

confirmUnpublish.title: Stop sharing the report with the tables?
confirmUnpublish.message: Every table phone currently reading the report loses access to it immediately. You can publish it again at any time.

confirmReopen.title: Reopen this session?
confirmReopen.message: Tables can record again and the report stops being final. Participants keep reading the version that was frozen when the session closed, until you close it again.

confirmPublish.title: Publish report to table phones?
confirmPublish.message: Every table's recording phone will be able to view this report and download the PDF. Only approved findings and AI summaries are included — unreviewed drafts stay private. You can unpublish at any time.

speaking.caveat: The phone recording this table changed during the session; voices cannot be matched across the parts, so this covers the fullest part only.
speaking.ariaLabel: Share of speaking time per detected voice
speaking.note: Detected voices, not identified by name — from the clearest single recording. An estimate of talk-time, not of participation or influence.

failure.retryingNext: Retrying automatically — attempt {attempt} of {max}, next in {seconds} s.

reason.PROVIDER_AUTH: The provider rejected the API key or this model (HTTP 401/403). Check the key, the plan and the model name in Settings, then run it again.
reason.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT: The provider is rate-limiting requests (HTTP 429). The job waits and retries by itself — do not start another run.
reason.PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The provider did not answer in time. The job retries by itself; if it keeps failing, the provider is slow or unreachable.
reason.PROVIDER_HTTP: The provider returned an error. The job retries by itself unless the provider rejected the request outright.
reason.SCHEMA_INVALID: The model answered, but not in the required format, three times in a row. Run it again; if it repeats, try another model.
reason.NOT_CONFIGURED: No provider is configured for this step — add the key or endpoint in Settings.
reason.NO_TRANSCRIPT: There is no transcript to analyse. Transcribe the recording first.
reason.AUDIO_MISSING: The audio file is missing on the server, so it cannot be transcribed again.
reason.RERUN_EMPTY: The new analysis came back with no findings for a table that already had some, so the previous findings were kept. Nothing was lost; run the analysis again if you wanted them replaced.
reason.CANCELLED: Cancelled by an organizer. Run it again when ready.
reason.UNKNOWN: It failed for a reason the app did not recognise; the detail below is what the server recorded.

code.STORAGE_FULL: The server ran out of space while assembling this recording. The uploaded audio is still here — free some space, then try again.
code.CHUNKS_GONE: Parts of the upload are missing from storage, so the audio cannot be rebuilt. This table needs to record the session again.
code.CHUNK_CORRUPTED: A piece of the upload failed its checksum, so the audio cannot be trusted. This table needs to record the session again.
code.AUDIO_DELETED: The audio was deleted while it was being assembled.
code.UPLOAD_TIMED_OUT: The phone stopped uploading and did not come back. Whatever reached the server is kept; the table can record again.
code.UPLOAD_ABANDONED: Waiting for this upload was stopped by an organizer. The audio already received is kept.
code.RATE_LIMITED: The provider is rate-limiting requests (HTTP 429). The job waits and retries by itself — do not start another run.
code.LIVE_CAPTIONS_MISSING: Final transcription is off and the caption session never wrote a transcript. Re-transcribe from the stored audio.
code.LIVE_CAPTIONS_UNREADABLE: Final transcription is off and the caption file could not be read. Re-transcribe from the stored audio.
code.LIVE_CAPTIONS_EMPTY: Final transcription is off and the captions contained no text. Re-transcribe from the stored audio.
code.DEVICE_SILENT: The phone went silent mid-session and the table was released. Whatever reached the server is kept.
code.ROUND_CONTINUED: The table finished early while the session was still open, then carried on: this is the first part of the session, the rest is in the recording below it.

state.AUDIO_INVALID: The uploaded audio could not be validated.
state.TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED: The transcription provider did not return a transcript. The audio is untouched, so this can be tried again.
state.ANALYSIS_FAILED: The AI analysis did not complete. The transcript is untouched, so this can be run again.
state.UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE: Not all of the recording reached the server.
